Name: Amphiaraus
Description: a hero of the war of the Seven Against Thebes who became an oracular spirit of the Underworld after his death

Name: Angelos
Description: a daughter of Zeus and Hera who became an underworld goddess

Name: Askalaphos
Description: the son of Acheron and Orphne who tended the Underworld orchards before being transformed into a screech owl by Demeter

Name: Cerberus
Description: the three-headed hound who guarded the gates of Hades

Name: Charon
Description: ferryman of Hades

Name: Empusa
Description: a monstrous underworld spirit or spirits with flaming hair, the leg of a goat and a leg of bronze. They are also servants of Hecate.

Name: Erebos
Description: the primeval god of darkness, his mists encircled the underworld and filled the hollows of the earth

Name: Erinyes
Description: the Furies, goddesses of retribution, known as "The Kindly Ones"

Name: Alecto
Description: the unceasing one

Name: Tisiphone
Description: avenger of murder

Name: Megaera
Description: the jealous one

Name: Hecate
Description: goddess of magic, witchcraft, the night, moon, ghosts, and necromancy

Name: Aiakos
Description: Judges of the Dead - former mortal king of Aegina, guardian of the keys of Hades and judge of the men of Europe

Name: Minos
Description: Judges of the Dead - former mortal king of Crete and judge of the final vote

Name: Rhadamanthys
Description: Judges of the Dead - former mortal lawmaker and judge of the men of Asia

Name: Keuthonymos
Description: an Underworld spirit and father of Menoetes

Name: Cronus
Description: deposed king of the Titans; after his release from Tartarus he was appointed king of the Island of the Blessed

Name: Lamia
Description: a vampiric Underworld spirit or spirits in the train of Hecate

Name: Lampades
Description: torch-bearing Underworld nymphs

Name: Orphne
Description: a Lampad nymph of Hades, mother of Askalaphos

Name: Macaria
Description: daughter of Hades and goddess of blessed death (not to be confused with the daughter of Heracles

Name: Melinoe
Description: daughter of Persephone and Zeus who presided over the propitiations offered to the ghosts of the dead

Name: Menoetes
Description: an Underworld spirit who herded the cattle of Hades

Name: Mormo
Description: a fearsome Underworld spirit or spirits in the train of Hecate

Name: Nyx
Description: the primeval goddess of night

Name: Hades
Description: God of underworld and all things beneath the earth

Name: Persephone
Description: queen of the underworld, wife of Hades and goddess of spring growth

Name: Acheron
Description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of woe

Name: Kokytos
Description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of wailing

Name: Lethe
Description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of forgetfulness

Name: Phlegethon
Description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of fire

Name: Styx
Description: Rivers of the Underworld - the river of hatred and oaths

Name: Tartarus
Description: Rivers of the Underworld - the primeval god of the dark, stormy pit of Hades

Name: Thanatos
Description: Rivers of the Underworld - spirit of death and minister of Hades
